content: For individuals who successfully achieve weight loss, it is crucial to provide long-term support to sustain their progress. Regular follow-up appointments are necessary to monitor their body weight consistently. Encouraging self-monitoring strategies, such as periodic weigh-ins and tracking physical activity, is highly recommended to empower individuals in managing their weight effectively. This continuous support plays a vital role in preventing weight regain and preserving the positive outcomes attained during the initial weight loss phase. Furthermore, maintaining a physical activity level of approximately 200 to 300 minutes per week is advised to promote long-term weight stability.
